title: IntimacyEscalationLedger Event
description: Append-only event log tracking intimacy milestones per character pair. Prevents 'first kiss' duplication, enforces escalation order, and enforces sex_scene_frequency constraints for erotica/high-heat genres. character_pair is a sorted tuple so it is canonical regardless of who is POV.

character_pair.description: Sorted tuple [char_id_a, char_id_b] (alphabetically sorted UUIDs). Canonical representation regardless of POV.

event_type.description: Milestone type. first_touch through first_explicit must occur in order. explicit_scene tracks all sex scenes (used for frequency enforcement in erotica profile).

description.description: One-sentence summary of what happened (for dashboard display and duplication prevention).

chapter_number.description: Denormalized chapter number for frequency/escalation queries.

consent_present.description: For explicit events: was enthusiastic consent clearly established? Null for non-explicit events. Feeds consent_arc tracking.
